newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Car and truck sales drop sharply in Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Car and truck sales drop sharply in Colombia.

text.p: Car and truck sales in Colombia dropped 15.9 percent in August from the same month last year, a motor industry report said.
Compiled by local subsidiaries of General Motors Corp, Mazda Motor Corp and Renault SA, the report said 9,460 cars and trucks were sold in August 1996 against 11,250 in August 1995.
Vehicle sales totalled 77,867 during the first eight months of 1996, down 13.4 percent from sales of 89,875 during the same period last year, the report said.

Imported vehicles accounted for 31.6 percent of all car and truck sales in Colombia in August. Total import sales reflected the industrywide slowdown, however, with 2,995 vehicles sold in August 1996 compared with 3,847 in August 1995.
